_why:
The spec marks ALL 9 fields of WebhookConfigSaveRequestDTO as `required`, including `authToken`, `apiVersion`, `enabled` and `interrupted`. It is an artifact of Asaas's spec generator (the same pattern appears in other SaveRequests). In the real API only `name`, `url`, `email`, `sendType` and `events` are mandatory: `authToken` is optional (without it, the `asaas-access-token` header is simply not sent), `apiVersion` defaults to 3, `enabled` to true, `interrupted` to false.

Requiring them would make the simulator STRICTER than Asaas — a 400 where the real API accepts. It is exactly the silent divergence this project exists to prevent: the developer tunes the code to please the mock and breaks in production.

HISTORY: this overlay also removed a spurious `enum` at the level of the `events` array (a `type: array` field that ALSO carried an `enum`, when the correct enum is already in `items.$ref`). That defect exists in 6 places in the spec and was fixed AT THE ROOT, in the codegen — `emit()` now tests `type` before `enum`. Do not patch it case by case.
